marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind southwest 15 knots diminishing to light this evening then
increasing to northeast 20 early Wednesday morning. Wind veering to southeast 25
near noon Wednesday then increasing to northwest 35 Wednesday
evening. Snow or rain Wednesday evening. Fog patches forming near
midnight and dissipating near noon Wednesday. Visibility 1 mile or less in fog
patches and as low as 1 mile in precipitation. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 metre or less building to 2 Wednesday
evening.<br/>
